model.name: Canonical ref-slot registry + trace-audit calibration
model.scheduleNote: MOVED S27->S28 2026-07-01 (PO re-scope). Foundational; planner builds T27.5 under S28 on Tron's go. Architect design 05da0584a + slot inventory 76c3a102b.
model.description: Establish a CANONICAL ref-slot registry {class, classes[], method, methods[], ownerIor, children, implementations, tests, requirements, tasks, useCases, parent, coveredRequirements, subtasks, verifies} that every migration + audit imports, each slot tagged forward/back/cross + token/edge/self classified - so NO ref-slot hides (root fix for the ownerIor + Test.methods slot-misses in R27.4) and ~500 auth-token false-positives are excluded. THEN calibrate trace-audit's orphan metric: add non-chain types to ORPHAN_BY_DESIGN, add Requirement->tasks + Sprint-roots to the walk. Result: the orphan + dangling metrics become HONEST (a non-zero count = real debt), which is what makes R27.6's TRUE-dangling inventory measurable.
model.tronQuote: > Derived from reconciling the trace-audit 2207-orphan metric vs R27.4's 51 orphan-Methods; PO ratified capture 2026-07-01. Make the INSTRUMENT honest.

discoverySource.measured: ~2207 audit-orphans = ~1600 benign non-chain (TestCase/Device/File/Room/... never-0) + ~382 walk-gap (Requirement->useCases not tasks -> all Tasks counted) + small overlap with the 51 real Method-orphans. The metric over-counts benign data + a walk-gap -> misleading.

model.crossRefNote: R27.5 = the INSTRUMENT (registry + honest metric); R27.6 = the DEBT it surfaces; R27.4 = where the first hidden slots (ownerIor, Test.methods) appeared; R24.5 owns trace:audit:strict.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A canonical ref-slot registry lists every ref-bearing slot {class, classes[], method, methods[], ownerIor, children, implementations, tests, requirements, tasks, useCases, parent, coveredRequirements, subtasks, verifies}; every migration + audit imports it so no slot is scanned ad-hoc.
Each slot is tagged forward / back / cross and classified token/edge/self, so back-edges (ownerIor, Test.methods) and cross-refs are covered, not just forward chain.
~500 auth-token false-positives (non-ref token strings) are classified as token (not edge) and excluded from the dangling/orphan counts.
trace-audit orphan metric calibrated: non-chain types added to ORPHAN_BY_DESIGN + Requirement->tasks + Sprint-roots added to the walk (the benign ~2207 metric drops to real chain-orphans).
After the registry + calibration, a non-zero orphan/dangling count indicates REAL debt (trustworthy enough to hard-gate); R27.6's true-dangling inventory is measurable against it.
Re-run trace:audit: token false-positives excluded, all slots covered, metric reflects only real chain debt.

trace:audit FLAGS any unit with no model.uuid OR a path/uuid mismatch (file basename != model.uuid) - catching bash/tooling artifacts like the undefined.scenario.json where a backtick ate the uuid field. This is a structural no-uuid gate, cheap + recurrence-proof.
